title: 177. Implement Stack using Queues

examples.explanation: Push 1 then push 2. Top returns 2, pop removes and returns 2, then empty returns false (encoded as 0).
Push 1. Top returns 1, pop returns 1, then the stack is empty so empty returns true (encoded as 1).
Push 1, 2, 3. Pop returns 3, pop returns 2, top returns 1, and empty returns false (0) because 1 remains.

hints: Simulate a stack with two queues: on push, move all elements so the newest element is always at the front.
Pop and top read from the front of the primary queue; empty checks whether it has no elements. Encode empty as 1 for true and 0 for false.
